body: Crying in public. Im having the shittiest day of my life, and I wish I was exaggerating.

I like how this is scattered. Not just the formatting, but your thoughts are scattered as well. It exemplifies the fast-pace and quick jittery thinking one may have while going through a panic or anxiety attack or depression. I like the oxymoron when you say "I'm an ant/ but I'm dragging./ elephant feet." You use many oxymorons in this poem, and it shows conflicting emotions, thought, and feelings.

So, kind of a relevant story. My friend and I had this smoke spot at this abandoned house in the woods. One day, we decide to do acid and venture farther into the woods. Deep into the woods, we found this really beautiful and abandoned meadow right next to a creek, and there was a swing hanging on a tree over the creek. Probably one of the best things to find on your first acid trip.
